question: For $x\in[-1,1]$, determine the range of $$f(x)=\sin^{-1}x+\cos^{-1}x.$$ Justify whether the function assumes more than one value.

options.A: Range: $[0,\pi]$; the function assumes infinitely many values
options.B: Range: $\left\{\frac{\pi}{2}\right\}$; the function assumes only one value
options.C: Range: $\left\{-\frac{\pi}{2},\frac{\pi}{2}\right\}$; the function assumes two values
options.D: Range: $(0,\pi)$; the function assumes every value in this interval
